section_18_spec_battery_run.headline: §17c blocker FIXED and full spec battery captured. The delivery gap was NOT CM staleness or a missing overlay file — both reference ports were already delivered but neither covers the crashing path.

delivery_gap_diagnosis.port_714255f46_vpe_tp1_mask: IN HEAD (ancestor) AND in the 14-key overlay CM, in the PATCHED version — but ORTHOGONAL: it guards VocabParallelEmbedding.forward; the §17c crash never routes through VPE.
delivery_gap_diagnosis.port_2608f81d3_embed_outside: IN HEAD (ancestor) AND in the overlay (dflash/speculator.py::_run_model, inherited by DFlash2Speculator) — but the crash is NOT in the drafter forward it moved out.
delivery_gap_diagnosis.actual_crash_site: CandidateSelector._score_edges (vllm/model_executor/models/qwen3_dflash2.py), a distinct @support_torch_compile region: raw advanced-index gathers into the [vocab, rank] codebooks — successor_table[candidate_ids] and predecessor_table[predecessor_ids] (predecessor_ids includes anchor_token_ids). vocab=248320 == the assert bound, confirmed on-PVC from the drafter config.json.
delivery_gap_diagnosis.trigger: At spec warmup the drafter input_ids buffer is never filled with valid tokens, so anchor_token_ids carry uninitialized / -1 sentinel ids -> predecessor_ids -> OOB gather inside the compiled selector -> inductor bounds assert 'index out of bounds: 0 <= tmp17 < 248320'. Same -1-sentinel class as §10/§11b, but a THIRD site the two ported fixes do not touch — so the §17 resume levers (porting be990b350/962069e51) would NOT have fixed it.
